subject: Interactive sessions dropping + retry flood — PulseHealth
messages:
From: PulseHealth Platform <alerts@pulsehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Torres <amelia@pulsehealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@pulsehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: [PulseHealth] sudden session terminations and spike in 5xx/429

Hi David —

We're seeing a sharp increase since ~08:45 PT where interactive chat sessions to your hosted endpoint are closing unexpectedly for our users. Symptoms:
- ~60% of impacted sessions show an abrupt TCP close from the server side after 45–65s.
- Several services report 5xx and 429 spikes correlated with the same timeframe.
- Clients are retrying aggressively (every 1–2s) and we see a surge in requests that then triggers rate-limiting.

I've attached a short log tail and a sample of session ids. Can you triage? This is impacting our clinician workflow.

Attachments: logs_tail_0425.txt, pulsehealth-session-id-samples.csv

Thanks,
Amelia
Platform Reliability, PulseHealth
From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: PulseHealth Platform <alerts@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: Amelia Torres <amelia@pulsehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [PulseHealth] sudden session terminations and spike in 5xx/429

Thanks Amelia — apologies for the disruption. We're on it. Quick notes: 
- Could you confirm whether your clients are using streaming keepalive (HTTP/1.1 chunked or HTTP/2 ping) and whether there's a proxy in front that might have a 60s idle timeout?
- We will immediately throttle automated retries server-side and spin up a dedicated routing lane for your traffic while we investigate.

I've looped in Marissa (CS) and engineering. We'll follow up in the next 20–30 minutes with an initial mitigation.

Best,
David
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Torres <amelia@pulsehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: PulseHealth: interactive session drops + retry flood (urgent)

Team —

PulseHealth reports abrupt session closes (45–65s) and a correlated spike in 5xx/429 due to client retries. Attachments from the customer are in the thread and on the shared drive (linked in metadata). Immediate asks:
1) Sean/Infra: can you check gateway/proxy idle timeouts and connection keepalive metrics for the last hour? Suspect mismatch between LB idle timeout and client keepalive.
2) Stephanie/Support: please prepare a short customer-facing mitigation note advising backoff configuration and temporarily disabling aggressive retry for streaming clients.
3) Logan/Runtime: if we need to toggle a short-term server-side mitigation (e.g., short-circuit to non-streaming completion or increase connection timeout), what's the fastest safe change?

This is elevated; if we need exec attention I'll loop in leadership.

Thanks — David
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: RE: PulseHealth: interactive session drops + retry flood (urgent)

On Mon, Apr 25, 2027 at 09:40 David Kim <david@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
>
> PulseHealth reports abrupt session closes (45–65s) and a correlated spike in 5xx/429 due to client retries.

Quick update from initial investigation:
- We see a pattern where the upstream edge LB is issuing FIN after 60s of idle activity for long-lived streaming connections. Many PulseHealth clients stream intermittently (long think times between tokens), so the LB treats the connection as idle and closes it.
- When the LB closes the TCP stream mid-chunk we return connection-level errors that propagate as 5xx to the client. The client SDKs then immediately retry without exponential backoff, creating a retry storm and triggering our global rate-limiter which starts returning 429s.

Immediate mitigations we can apply in the next 10–30 minutes (no code changes):
A) Increase edge Load Balancer idle timeout from 60s -> 180s for PulseHealth's routing lane (config change).
B) Enable server-side "graceful stream close" where we detect half-closed and send a final structured error with Retry-After (short-term patch, small config toggle).
C) Add a temporary per-client retry window: any given session id -> 1 retry per 10s (rate-limit exception rules).

Longer-term actions:
- Update SDK guidance to use application-level keepalives (whitespace pings or periodic noop frames) and exponential backoff by default.
- Improve streaming error semantics so clients receive 503+Retry-After instead of opaque 5xx.

I'll start with A and C immediately; need ops approval to change LB timeout for this lane. I'll open JIRA-RED-7124 and post runbook steps.

—Sean
Senior Infra Engineer
From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@pulsehealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interactive sessions dropping + retry flood — PulseHealth

Amelia / Rajiv —

Thanks for the details and the logs. Quick summary of what we're doing now (live):
- We're increasing the edge idle timeout for your traffic lane from 60s to 180s (should stop mid-chunk closes).
- We're deploying a temporary rate-limit rule to limit aggressive client retries (1 retry per 10s/window for the same session id).
- Engineering will enable "graceful stream close" today so disconnected sessions return a structured 503 with Retry-After rather than an opaque 5xx.

Can we schedule a 30-minute maintenance window today at 16:00 PT to apply the LB change and validate with you? If that doesn't work we'll do an immediate out-of-band change and follow up.

I've attached a short customer-facing KB we'll send after the window with SDK recommendations.

Best,
David
From: Amelia Torres <amelia@pulsehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@pulsehealth.com>, PulseHealth Platform <alerts@pulsehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interactive sessions dropping + retry flood — PulseHealth

Thanks David — 16:00 PT works for us on 4/28. We'll pause non-critical experiments during that window and confirm if the clinician workflow is green after the change. Appreciate the quick coordination and the temporary throttling while you patch the graceful-close logic.

One ask: after the change, can you share a short checklist we can use to validate (expected metrics / log signatures)? We want something our on-call can follow.

—Amelia
Platform Reliability, PulseHealth
